questions.stem: In a global health lecture, the topic of smallpox eradication is discussed, highlighting one of the major public health achievements of the 20th century. The eradication of smallpox was declared at different times in various countries. A medical student interested in the history of infectious diseases asks about the year in which India, a country with a large population and diverse geographic regions, was declared smallpox-free. In which year was India officially declared free of smallpox?
